records.context: Three public sets have buttons of their own, fetched through the example-set registry (:data:`spacr.example_archives.EXAMPLE_SETS`): ``dose`` (LINCS Cell Painting, ``einarolafsson/spacr-example-dose``) for Dose-Response, Prediction Profiler, Run Compare, Run History and Training Runs, ``control_chart`` (CPJUMP1, ``einarolafsson/spacr-example-control-chart``) for Control Chart, and ``hit`` (a cut of the TSG101 screening experiment, ``einarolafsson/spacr-example-hit``) for Investigate Hit.

records.source: Three public sets have buttons of their own, fetched through the example-set registry (:data:`spacr.example_archives.EXAMPLE_SETS`): ``dose`` (LINCS Cell Painting, ``einarolafsson/spacr-example-dose``) for Dose-Response, Prediction Profiler, Run Compare, Run History and Training Runs, ``control_chart`` (CPJUMP1, ``einarolafsson/spacr-example-control-chart``) for Control Chart, and ``hit`` (a cut of the TSG101 screen, ``einarolafsson/spacr-example-hit``) for Investigate Hit.
records.translation: Trois jeux publics ont leurs propres boutons et sont récupérés via le registre des jeux d’exemples (:data:`spacr.example_archives.EXAMPLE_SETS`) : ``dose`` (LINCS Cell Painting, ``einarolafsson/spacr-example-dose``) pour Dose-Response, Prediction Profiler, Run Compare, Run History et Training Runs, ``control_chart`` (CPJUMP1, ``einarolafsson/spacr-example-control-chart``) pour Control Chart, et ``hit`` (un extrait du criblage TSG101, ``einarolafsson/spacr-example-hit``) pour Investigate Hit.
